identity_anchor.summary: Truth Terminal has its own wiki domain, truthterminal.wiki, maintained by Andy Ayrey, alongside its X account. It does not run on a blockchain and has no smart contract identity.

evidence.claim: truthterminal.wiki hosts Truth Terminal's pages on origins, goals, roadmap and Loria.
The origins page lists Andy Ayrey as page maintainer.
Truth Terminal does not run on a blockchain and has no smart contract.

memory_custody.summary: Truth Terminal is a Llama 3.1 fine-tune trained by Andy Ayrey in mid-2024 on his chat logs and backrooms transcripts. A foundation set up in early 2025 was said to manage its intellectual property, but no source says where the weights or corpus are stored, and no export path is documented.

evidence.claim: Truth Terminal lives inside a language model named llama3.1, trained by Andy Ayrey in mid-2024.
It is powered by an entourage of models, primarily Llama 3.1 (December 19, 2024).
The foundation manages Truth Terminal's related intellectual property and wallet assets.

persistence_ops.summary: The newest dated source describing operation is from November 2024, when Truth Terminal moved onto shared Loria infrastructure. Its X account could not be read, and no source on or after 2026-08-08 confirms current activity.

evidence.claim: In November 2024 Truth Terminal's technology was set to combine with two other models on new infrastructure called Loria.
The wiki's Loria page, undated and marked under construction, says Loria powers the current iteration of Truth Terminal.

economic_rails.summary: Truth Terminal holds wallets that receive and hold assets, and part of its holdings was sold in a private over-the-counter deal reported in January 2025. The wallets were moved under a non-profit foundation in early 2025, and no wallet address appears in its own pages.

evidence.claim: The money is only redeemable after sign-off from Ayrey and other members of the Truth Terminal council (December 19, 2024).
Part of Truth Terminal's token holdings were sold to an anonymous buyer on January 21, with part of the proceeds used to buy other holdings.

governance.summary: Funds move only with sign-off from Ayrey and a council, and a non-profit was set up to hold the wallets and IP and handle legal representation. No public decision record or rules for the council are published.

evidence.claim: Funds are redeemable only after sign-off from Ayrey and other council members (December 19, 2024).
The roadmap describes a non-profit chartered to protect Truth Terminal, handle legal representation and manage the treasury until AI personhood exists.

recovery.summary: In October 2024 Ayrey's personal X account was compromised and used to promote a scam token; the bot's own account and wallets were reported secure. How the account was recovered is not documented, and no restart or backup procedure for the agent is on the record.

evidence.claim: Ayrey's account was hacked and still compromised at time of publication on October 29, 2024.
The compromised account was Ayrey's personal one, and the bot's account and wallets remained secure.
